company.description: The company name as given in the input.

studio_archetype.description: One of: founder-led boutique, DP-led, agency, huge production company, unknown. Phrase naturally but keep one of these families identifiable.

operating_model.description: How this company actually works day to day, based on evidence. UNKNOWN if unsupported.

creative_dna.description: Short, specific, evidence-based observations about their creative identity. Empty array if none supported.

visual_dna.description: Short, specific, evidence-based observations about their visual style. Empty array if none supported.

decision_maker.description: Who makes creative decisions here, inferred from contact title and evidence. UNKNOWN if unsupported.

buyer_personality.description: How this company is likely to evaluate and buy a service like Colorkaar's. UNKNOWN if unsupported.

human_angle.description: Exactly ONE concrete, specific human observation. Never a generic compliment. UNKNOWN if unsupported.

colorkaar_angle.description: One sentence: why Colorkaar specifically matters to this company. Not an email.

conversation_starter.description: A specific topic to open a conversation with, not a compliment.

avoid.description: Topics, comparisons, or tones that would misread the room with this specific lead.

priority.description: Your proposed priority tier. Recomputed deterministically downstream — reason honestly.

relationship_score.description: Your proposed 0-100 relationship score. Recomputed deterministically downstream — reason honestly.

confidence.description: 0-100. How much of this analysis is grounded in real evidence vs. inference.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences on why you chose the human angle and Colorkaar angle, and why this confidence level. Debug only, dropped before export.
